defmodule BlockchainNotifier do
  @moduledoc """
  Smart contract notification service for encrypted blockchain storage.
  Handles event notifications when contract state changes are committed.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @aes_key :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(32)
  @iv_length 16

  defmodule ContractState do
    defstruct [:owner, :balance, :metadata, :subscribers, :nonce]
  end

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(_opts) do
    {:ok, %ContractState{owner: nil, balance: 0, metadata: %{}, subscribers: [], nonce: 0}}
  end

  # Public API: register a subscriber with notification preferences
  def subscribe(address, notification_email, display_name) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:subscribe, address, notification_email, display_name})
  end

  # Public API: execute a state transition (transfer)
  def transfer(from, to, amount, memo) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:transfer, from, to, amount, memo})
  end

  # Encrypt storage slot using AES-256-CBC
  defp encrypt_slot(data) when is_binary(data) do
    iv = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(@iv_length)
    padded = pkcs7_pad(data, 16)
    encrypted = :crypto.crypto_one_time(:aes_256_cbc, @aes_key, iv, padded, true)
    Base.encode64(iv <> encrypted)
  end

  defp decrypt_slot(encoded) do
    decoded = Base.decode64!(encoded)
    <<iv::binary-size(@iv_length), ciphertext::binary>> = decoded
    decrypted = :crypto.crypto_one_time(:aes_256_cbc, @aes_key, iv, ciphertext, false)
    pkcs7_unpad(decrypted)
  end

  defp pkcs7_pad(data, block_size) do
    pad_len = block_size - rem(byte_size(data), block_size)
    data <> :binary.copy(<<pad_len>>, pad_len)
  end

  defp pkcs7_unpad(data) do
    pad_len = :binary.last(data)
    binary_part(data, 0, byte_size(data) - pad_len)
  end

  # Validate blockchain address format (hex, 40 chars)
  defp valid_address?(addr) when is_binary(addr) do
    Regex.match?(~r/^0x[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$/, addr)
  end
  defp valid_address?(_), do: false

  # Sanitize display name - remove obviously dangerous chars
  # but preserve unicode for international names
  defp sanitize_display_name(name) when is_binary(name) do
    name
    |> String.replace(~r/[<>"'&]/, "")
    |> String.slice(0, 64)
  end

  # Encode the notification recipient field per RFC 5322
  # Format: "Display Name" <email@domain>
  defp encode_recipient(display_name, email) do
    sanitized_name = sanitize_display_name(display_name)
    # Encode the full recipient for the To: header
    "\"#{sanitized_name}\" <#{email}>"
  end

  # Build notification headers for state change event
  defp build_notification_headers(subscriber, event_type, contract_addr) do
    {_addr, email, display_name} = subscriber
    recipient = encode_recipient(display_name, email)
    timestamp = DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.to_iso8601()

    # Construct headers as a single string block
    headers = """
    From: BlockchainNotifier <noreply@chain.internal>
    To: #{recipient}
    Subject: Contract Event [#{event_type}] on #{contract_addr}
    Date: #{timestamp}
    X-Contract-Address: #{contract_addr}
    MIME-Version: 1.0
    Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
    """

    String.trim(headers)
  end

  # Validate email format
  defp valid_email?(email) when is_binary(email) do
    # Basic structural check
    Regex.match?(~r/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/, email)
  end
  defp valid_email?(_), do: false

  # Handle subscribe
  def handle_call({:subscribe, address, email, display_name}, _from, state) do
    cond do
      not valid_address?(address) ->
        {:reply, {:error, :invalid_address}, state}
      not valid_email?(email) ->
        {:reply, {:error, :invalid_email}, state}
      not is_binary(display_name) ->
        {:reply, {:error, :invalid_name}, state}
      true ->
        encrypted_email = encrypt_slot(email)
        subscriber = {address, encrypted_email, display_name}
        new_state = %{state | subscribers: [subscriber | state.subscribers]}
        {:reply, {:ok, :subscribed}, new_state}
    end
  end

  # Handle transfer with notification dispatch
  def handle_call({:transfer, from, to, amount, memo}, _from, state) do
    with true <- valid_address?(from),
         true <- valid_address?(to),
         true <- is_integer(amount) and amount > 0 do

      new_nonce = state.nonce + 1
      encrypted_memo = encrypt_slot(memo || "")

      # Store transaction in encrypted form
      tx_record = %{
        from: from,
        to: to,
        amount: amount,
        memo: encrypted_memo,
        nonce: new_nonce
      }

      Logger.info("Transaction committed: nonce=#{new_nonce}")

      # Notify relevant subscribers
      notifications = notify_subscribers(state.subscribers, tx_record, to)

      new_state = %{state | nonce: new_nonce, balance: state.balance + amount}
      {:reply, {:ok, tx_record, notifications}, new_state}
    else
      _ -> {:reply, {:error, :invalid_transfer}, state}
    end
  end

  # Dispatch notifications to subscribers watching this contract
  defp notify_subscribers(subscribers, tx_record, contract_addr) do
    Enum.map(subscribers, fn subscriber ->
      {addr, encrypted_email, display_name} = subscriber
      # Decrypt email for sending
      email = decrypt_slot(encrypted_email)
      # Build the raw notification with decrypted subscriber info
      decrypted_sub = {addr, email, display_name}
      headers = build_notification_headers(decrypted_sub, "transfer", contract_addr)
      body = "Transfer of #{tx_record.amount} to #{tx_record.to} (nonce: #{tx_record.nonce})"
      send_notification(headers, body)
      {addr, :notified}
    end)
  end

  defp send_notification(headers, body) do
    # In production, this would connect to SMTP relay
    Logger.debug("Sending notification:\n#{headers}\n\n#{body}")
    {:ok, :sent}
  end
end
